✨ awesome-generative-ai-apps | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide developers and entrepreneurs with ready-to-launch, monetizable generative AI SaaS applications that can be quickly deployed and branded as their own.
✨ Key Features: • 50+ complete AI SaaS products • Clone, deploy, and monetize applications • One-click Vercel deployment
📖 Summary: This repository provides over 50 open-source generative AI applications that users can clone, deploy, and monetize. Each application is a complete SaaS product with integrated authentication, billing, and AI functionalities, designed for easy deployment on platforms like Vercel.
